$comment: Backend contract the shared admin UI (shared/admin/js/agent-models-ui.js + host.js) relies on. Every backend (VM, EdgeOne) must satisfy it; tests/test_backend_contract.py runs the same scenarios against both. When the UI starts reading a new field, add it here first.

host_glue.$comment: What the page hosting agent-models-ui.js must provide (VM: shared/admin/js/core.js; EdgeOne: agent-edgeone/admin.js).
host_glue.state.stats: the last GET HOST.api.stats response, loaded together with the config

stats.$time_granularity: EdgeOne rewrites an unchanged status at most every 10s per isolate (KV write budget); a status change is written at once. VM is exact.

entry.status: int (HTTP status of the last attempt; 200 = ok)
entry.time: int, epoch ms of the last attempt

response.agent.active_keys: object: agent_model -> key_label of the key that served the last successful call

response.status: int (upstream HTTP status) when the upstream answered

response.models: list of upstream model ids (strings) or objects with id
